verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA B200 / DGX B200 is GPU hardware and a data-center system platform, not an AI agent or assistant that could act as an MCP client consuming tools. Plugging in MCP servers is a category error for this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence shows it shipping such a capability. The llms.txt documentation probe concerns docs for AI agents, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
